name: Messenger to Darkshire
summary: In Darkshire, Lord Ello Ebonlocke answers a plea for help from Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs and gnolls press against the town, but the plea cannot be granted.

sections.title: A Desperate Request Denied
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon of Redridge asks his old peer in Duskwood for troops. Blackrock orcs and gnolls are closing in on his town. Lord Ello Ebonlocke answers in anger. Darkshire struggles against the living dead, ravenous beasts, and cursed magic on every side. Ebonlocke says the Night Watch exists because Stormwind abandoned Duskwood. Without its defenders, Darkshire would fall before a patrol could cross the forest.

sections.title: A Pattern of Abandonment
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon reads Ebonlocke's reply and sees a pattern of retreat across the kingdom. The Stormwind Army left Westfall, Darkshire was left to fend for itself, and Lakeshire's calls for aid have gone unanswered. Leaders across the kingdom whisper that this may be more than oversight or incompetence. Solomon now faces their suspicion of treachery at Stormwind's heart.

faq.q: Why won't Lord Ebonlocke send the Night Watch to help Lakeshire?
aliases: why no night watch for lakeshire
faq.answer: Darkshire is beset by undead, beasts, and foul sorcery. The Night Watch is a local militia formed after Stormwind withdrew its garrisons. If Ebonlocke sent his guards to Redridge, Darkshire would fall before they crossed the forest.

faq.q: What does Magistrate Solomon realize upon reading the response?
faq.answer: Solomon sees Lakeshire's plight as part of a kingdom-wide crisis. The army has retreated from Westfall and Darkshire has been left to defend itself. He suspects treachery in Stormwind's leadership, not simple neglect.
Duskwood's beleaguered citizens and leaders formed the Night Watch under Lord Ello Ebonlocke after Stormwind's forces abandoned the territory to darkness and rot.

faq.q: Where does Solomon go from here to get help?
faq.answer: With Darkshire refusing aid and Westfall overrun by the Defias Brotherhood, Lakeshire stands alone. Solomon looks to Stormwind's palace court for answers about why the crown will not protect its outlying territories.

faq.q: Did Stormwind officially pull out of Duskwood and Westfall?
faq.answer: Yes. As dark magic corrupted Duskwood and unrest erupted in Westfall, Stormwind's regular forces withdrew. Frontier towns raised local militias, including the Night Watch and the People's Militia, to survive.

faq.q: What is the relation between Solomon and Ebonlocke?
faq.answer: Solomon and Ebonlocke are long-standing peers and fellow magistrates who govern frontier towns. Solomon counted on their personal ties when he asked for troops, but Duskwood's dangers made it impossible for Ebonlocke to comply.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this dispatch reveals deep cracks in the southern kingdom. Outlying settlements are left discarded and defenseless.
As a human traveler, you can see how isolated the realm's towns have become while the royal court looks away.
